title: Billing Hold and Charge Dispute Amounts on Owed Courtesies (Hospital Account (Encounter Billing))
content:
**Rule.** On a Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account owed a service-recovery courtesy, when the account's holds-used count is at least one and a charge dispute inquiry was logged on the account, 15.00 USD is added to the courtesy; when the holds-used count is at least one and no charge dispute inquiry was logged, 5.00 is added; with no hold used, nothing.

| Holds used on the account | Charge dispute inquiry logged on the account | Amount added |
|---|---|---|
| one or more | yes | 15.00 |
| one or more | no | 5.00 |
| none | yes | nothing |
| none | no | nothing |

*Cases (hypothetical).* An account with one hold used for a coverage update and no charge dispute adds 5.00. An account with a charge dispute logged but no hold ever placed adds nothing.
